Based on the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) storage system. This system creates inefficiency because newer stock items are placed behind older ones, making them difficult to access. Consequently, the warehouse incurs significant time costs for reorganization whenever the latest inventory is required for shipment. An efficiency improvement would be to implement a more flexible storage strategy, such as a dynamic slotting system or a Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) approach for specific fast-moving items, to reduce handling time and improve access to current stock.
